prompt: Override toString on ColorSwatch, add toHex, and write summary(...) that joins swatches through String.valueOf. Complete the starter file, then run the tests.
explanation: toString is inherited from Object and returns something like ColorSwatch@1b6d3586, which is useless in a log; overriding it is the cheapest readability win a model type gets. Once it is overridden, string concatenation, println and String.valueOf all pick it up automatically, because every one of them ends up calling toString on the object. String.format("%02X", value) pads a hex value to two upper-case digits, which is what keeps 0 from printing as just "0".
hints: String.format("#%02X%02X%02X", red, green, blue) does the whole hex string in one call.
Build toString out of toHex() rather than repeating the formatting -- the expected text is "ColorSwatch[" + name + " " + hex + "]".
In summary, handle the null or empty array first, then loop appending ", " before every element except the first.
